answer.summary: Not infra or flakiness: the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. The API now generates SettingsRuntimeUpdateInput.settings as Record<string, any> instead of Record<string, object>, so the types check fails deterministically. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the regenerated file.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
